name: The Quartermaster
short_role: Stretch one chosen reserve across the whole defense.
question: Which reserve must still exist after first contact?
passive: Measured Stores: the first pack each Preparation costs 2 fewer materials, and a surviving Supply Cache releases 2 extra materials.
ability_text: Once per assault, restore up to 2 health and 2 ammunition to every living defender that can use them.
limitation: Thin Ledger: starts with 48 materials and 5 morale; reserves only pay off if they survive long enough to be used.
